Turtle Beach Recon 70 Gaming Headset Wired for Xbox Series X|S Xbox One PS5 PS4

Barcode:  0731855064557        Product Code:  TBS-6455-02        RRP:  £39.99

 

Product Description

Built for your next victory, your latest achievement and much more is the Turtle Beach® Recon 70 multiplatform gaming headset. Featuring Turtle Beach’s latest lightweight and comfortable headset design for hours of play, with high-quality 40mm speakers and over-ear premium synthetic leather cushions that let you hear every crisp high and thundering low while blocking noise. Plus, for even more immersive audio, the Recon 70 supports spatial sound technologies like Windows Sonic, Dolby Atmos, DTS Headphone: X and Sony 3D Audio for PS5™. Turtle Beach’s renowned high-sensitivity mic to ensure you are heard clearly and easily flips up to mute. Finally, the versatile 3.5mm connection makes it perfect for swapping between PlayStation® and Xbox controllers and PCs & mobile devices with 3.5mm connection.

 

Lightweight comfort

A lightweight design ensures complete comfort during those hours-long gaming sessions

 

High quality 40 mm speakers

Urivalled 40 mm over-ear speakers produce crisp highs and thundering lows

 

Flip-up mic

Turtle beach's renowned High-Sensitivity microphone picks up your voice loud and clear, flips up to mute

 

Premium ear cushions

Synthetic leather-wrapped ear cushions provide enhanced comfort, improved bass response and better noise isolation

 

Multiplatform compatibility

A gaming headset that works with Xbox Series X, Xbox One, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PC and mobile devices

 

Note: (a)Ensure that the headset is properly connected to their controller. If it is only part-connected, that stops the audio pulling through correctly and can also stop the microphone from working, (b) The microphone is fully set to open. If it is only part way open, the microphone will not work, (c) if there is a loud echo in the headset, this is because the microphone is picking up the TV audio. To remove the echo, the customer must mute the television and ensure that the game audio only comes through the headset
